children: Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. of Louisiana reported full-year 2026 revenue of $32.5M and net income of $6.17M, with diluted earnings per share of $2.02, driven by higher net interest income, loan growth and an expanded net interest margin versus fiscal 2025.
Revenue was $32.498M, compared with $30.462M in the prior year; YoY change 6.7%.
Net income was $6.174M, compared with $3.888M in the prior year; YoY change 58.8%.
Diluted EPS was $2.02, compared with $1.26 in the prior year; YoY change 60.3%.
Revenue growth and improved profitability were driven by higher net interest income and loan growth, lifting net income to $6.174M in FY2026 from $3.888M in FY2025.
Management shifted the loan mix toward commercial real estate and business loans, increasing originations and yielding a higher-yield loan portfolio.
Net interest margin expanded to 3.72% from 3.23%, reflecting higher asset yields and lower funding costs.
Launched mobile and internet banking along with remote deposit capture to support commercial clients and cross-selling efforts.
Asset quality remained strong with non-performing assets at 0.57% of assets, while the allowance for credit losses was increased to support portfolio growth.
